moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just two weeks away, offering a final long weekend before autumn.

angles.name: Weekend Vibe
angles.copy: That August Bank Holiday feeling is just around the corner! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer? Make it count!

angles.name: Planning Ahead
angles.copy: Two weeks to go until the August Bank Holiday! Perfect time to plan a last-minute getaway or a big family BBQ. What's on your agenda?

moments.title: Premier League returns
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off this Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal facing newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Game Week 1 Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is OVER! The Premier League is back this Friday! Who are you backing for the opening weekend, and who's got the toughest start?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off the new Premier League season at home to Coventry City this Friday! Big start for the Gunners, can they grab all three points?

moments.title: Ariana Grande continues O2 residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' continues its massive ten-night residency at The O2 Arena in London this week, with multiple dates until September 1st.

angles.name: London Gig Buzz
angles.copy: London is still buzzing with Ariana Grande fever! Her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' continues its incredible run at The O2 this week. Who's managed to get tickets?

angles.name: Pop Powerhouse
angles.copy: The pop queen herself, Ariana Grande, is commanding the stage in London all week! What's your favourite track from 'Eternal Sunshine'?

moments.title: The Weeknd plays Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' wraps up its five-night run at Wembley Stadium this week, celebrating his acclaimed album trilogy.

angles.name: Wembley Farewell
angles.copy: The Weeknd's epic Wembley run concludes this week! If you've been to the 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour', what was your highlight?

angles.name: Stadium Spectacle
angles.copy: Still got that 'Blinding Lights' feeling? The Weeknd is bringing his record-breaking stadium show to a close at Wembley. An unmissable experience!

moments.title: BBC Proms continues at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: The world's biggest classical music festival, BBC Proms, is in full swing at the Royal Albert Hall in London, running until September 12th.

angles.name: Classical Summer
angles.copy: A staple of the London summer, the BBC Proms continues to bring incredible classical music to the Royal Albert Hall. Have you caught a performance yet?

angles.name: Music for Everyone
angles.copy: From timeless classics to modern interpretations, the BBC Proms offers something for every music lover. A perfect way to spend a summer evening.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating genre-hopping music and UK club culture, takes place this weekend in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20-23.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Get ready, Dorset! We Out Here Festival brings its incredible blend of jazz, club culture, and electronic music this weekend. Who's heading to the fields?

angles.name: Dorset Sounds
angles.copy: The sound of summer festivals is calling from Dorset! We Out Here Festival promises a fantastic weekend of music from Thursday. Are you going?

moments.title: Green Man Festival begins in Wales
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated Green Man Festival, a celebration of music, arts, and culture, starts this Thursday, August 20th, in the Brecon Beacons, Wales.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is almost here! The Brecon Beacons will be alive with music and magic from Thursday. Who's got their wellies ready?

angles.name: Arts & Culture Escape
angles.copy: Our very own Green Man Festival kicks off this week! A fantastic showcase of music, art, and Welsh culture. What are you looking forward to most?

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires play Glasgow & Birmingham
moments.blurb: The supergroup Hollywood Vampires, featuring Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, and Joe Perry, are live in Glasgow tonight and Birmingham on Wednesday.

angles.name: Glasgow Rock N Roll
angles.copy: Glasgow, are you ready to rock? The Hollywood Vampires are at the OVO Hydro TONIGHT! What's your favourite track from the supergroup?

angles.name: Supergroup Show
angles.copy: Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, Joe Perry – the Hollywood Vampires are bringing their rock spectacle to Glasgow tonight and Birmingham on Wednesday!

moments.title: Sonu Nigam brings 'Revolution' to Wembley
moments.blurb: Bollywood icon Sonu Nigam performs his 'Revolution' show at OVO Arena Wembley this Sunday, August 23rd, featuring a full live band and immersive production.

angles.name: Bollywood Night Out
angles.copy: This Sunday, experience the 'Revolution' with Sonu Nigam at OVO Arena Wembley! A spectacular night of timeless Bollywood hits awaits.

angles.name: Global Vocalist
angles.copy: Sonu Nigam, one of India's most celebrated vocalists, takes to the Wembley stage on Sunday. Expect an emotional journey through decades of hits!

moments.title: The Voice UK is back
moments.blurb: A new series of The Voice UK premieres this Saturday, August 22nd, at 7pm on ITV1.

angles.name: Saturday Night TV
angles.copy: Get ready to turn those chairs! The Voice UK returns to ITV1 this Saturday night. Who are you hoping to see on the judging panel this year?

angles.name: New Talent Search
angles.copy: The search for the next singing superstar begins again! The Voice UK is back this weekend. Will you be tuning in?

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending early birthday wishes to the incredible Dua Lipa, who turns 31 on Thursday! What's your ultimate Dua Lipa dance track?

angles.name: Future Nostalgia
angles.copy: Thursday marks Dua Lipa's 31st birthday! Keep those 'Future Nostalgia' vibes going strong all week. What's your favourite album of hers?

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, this Thursday! What's your go-to Zep anthem?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Celebrate the incredible Robert Plant, turning 78 on Thursday! His voice defined an era. What's your favourite track he's featured on?

angles.name: Music & Inspiration
angles.copy: Celebrating Demi Lovato's 34th birthday on Thursday! An artist who continues to inspire through their music and advocacy. Send them some love!

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer

angles.name: 90s Rave Legend
angles.copy: Remember the rave days? Liam Howlett, the mastermind of The Prodigy, turns 55 on Friday! 'Firestarter' still goes off!

angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears this Friday! Still 'Shouting' about how good their music is. What's your favourite TFF song?

angles.name: Mad World
angles.copy: Celebrating Roland Orzabal's 65th birthday this Friday! The voice behind some of the most enduring hits of the 80s. A true legend.

angles.copy: Happy 48th birthday to The Strokes' main man, Julian Casablancas, this Saturday! Still influencing bands today. What's your favourite Strokes album?

angles.name: 00s Revival
angles.copy: The voice of a generation! Julian Casablancas of The Strokes turns 48 on Saturday. Relive those early 2000s indie vibes!
